title: Entity growth batch 03 — group C
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #199. Canonical publication prohibited until candidate validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet ecosystem distributed through mobile applications and a browser extension by Backpack.
entities.notes: Current first-party Backpack support explicitly describes Backpack Wallet as self-custodial, states private keys never leave the user device, and confirms mobile/browser distribution. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Fully non-custodial Hedera wallet ecosystem available through browser and device applications.
entities.notes: HashPack first-party history states development began in March 2021 and the wallet launched in October 2021 as a browser app and Chrome extension. Month precision is retained.

entities.summary: Self-custodial XRP Ledger wallet formerly branded Xumm and rebranded to Xaman in 2023.
entities.notes: First-party Xaman material explicitly preserves Xumm→Xaman continuity and describes Xaman as self-custodial. Initial Xumm launch date remains unresolved in this breadth pass.

entities.summary: Open-source self-custodial Algorand wallet ecosystem distributed on mobile and web.
entities.notes: Current first-party material explicitly states Pera is self-custodial and never holds users' keys. Initial wallet launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Open-source self-custodial Cardano light-wallet ecosystem from EMURGO that is currently being wound down following a security incident.
entities.notes: Current first-party Yoroi site explicitly says Yoroi and SecondFi are winding down. WLR therefore does not mark Yoroi active. The same first-party site says Yoroi has served users since 2018 and is self-custodial.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Backpack browser extension for wallet and dApp use on supported desktop browsers.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension boundary only; mobile is deferred. Current first-party wallet support explicitly describes Backpack as self-custodial, while the official download page establishes Chrome, Brave and Edge distribution. Original extension launch remains unresolved.
First-party HashPack history explicitly says the wallet launched in October 2021 as a browser-based app and dedicated Chrome extension. Mobile remains a separate runtime and is deferred.

products.summary: Current Xaman self-custodial XRP Ledger mobile wallet, continuing the former Xumm application lineage.
products.notes: The 2023 Xumm→Xaman transition is a rebrand, not an initial mobile-product launch date. Current first-party help links official App Store and Google Play versions.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Pera Wallet mobile application for Algorand accounts and dApp access.
products.notes: Selected mobile product only; Pera Web is deferred as a separate runtime. Exact original mobile launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Yoroi self-custodial Cardano browser extension, now within the wallet's announced wind-down phase.
products.notes: Current Yoroi site announces a wallet wind-down, so this product is not marked active. Firefox support already ended separately; current guidance points remaining extension users to Chrome, Brave or Edge. Initial extension launch date is not inferred from the entity's 2018 history.

evidence.title: What is Backpack Wallet?
evidence.notes: Current first-party Backpack support explicitly describes Backpack as a self-custodial crypto wallet and links browser, iOS and Android distribution.

evidence.title: Backpack Browser Extension
evidence.notes: Same first-party download authority specifically lists Backpack Browser Extension for Chrome, Brave and Edge. Kept as one source URL because a second custody source has not yet been established; candidate remains researching.

evidence.title: About HashPack
evidence.notes: Current first-party page states HashPack is a fully non-custodial Hedera wallet.

evidence.title: Solving 3 user experience challenges in crypto
evidence.notes: First-party HashPack history states the wallet launched in October 2021 as a browser app and dedicated Chrome extension, supporting month precision and the selected extension boundary.

evidence.title: Xumm Evolves into a New Era: Welcome, Xaman!
evidence.notes: First-party announcement establishes Xumm→Xaman rebrand continuity and states previously XRPL Labs/Xumm product functionality remains continuous.

evidence.title: What is Xaman?
evidence.notes: Current first-party help center identifies Xaman formerly Xumm as a self-custodial XRP Ledger wallet with keys kept on the user's device.

evidence.title: Self-Custody Explained: Why Pera Never Holds Your Keys
evidence.notes: Current first-party support explicitly states Pera never holds users' keys and private keys are generated and stored on users' devices.

evidence.title: Pera Algo Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party site distributes Pera Mobile and states Pera is a self-custodial Algorand wallet.

evidence.title: Yoroi - Light Wallet for Cardano
evidence.notes: Current first-party Yoroi site explicitly announces that Yoroi and SecondFi are winding down, while also describing Yoroi as a self-custodial open-source Cardano wallet with history since 2018.

evidence.title: Yoroi Terms and Conditions
evidence.notes: First-party terms define Yoroi as free open-source wallet software that does not make EMURGO or third parties custodians of user assets; the current site banner simultaneously establishes the wind-down phase.
